svg.text: The Edwardian Lift: the mechanism, side view
Drawn from build.py's geometry. Three poses:
jack pin in the head's slot:
Dashed arcs: where the lever's pins swing. Rails: where the router and the jack's head must go.
Where an arc meets a rail, something has to give: the link leans, the pin slides.
Router end, sideways ×9: the link leans
At both ends of the travel the pin comes 2.9 mm toward the pivot.
The link, 120 mm long, leans 1.4° to follow it; the router stays on its posts.
Jack end, sideways ×9: the pin slides in the slot
The head's slot (outlined) goes straight down the dotted line; the pin swings on
its arc and slides 5.8 mm along the slot's top. The slot is square to the
motion, so the head's height is exactly 220 mm × sin(tilt): the 2 : 1 holds.
pin joint: the parts either side turn about it
rails: a straight guide (the router's posts; the jack's own scissor)
Crank → jack screw → head (straight) → lever (arc, 2 : 1) → link → router (straight).
